       33. The reaction is catalyzed by solid nickel. Which of
           the following describes the effect of the catalyst on
           the reaction?

          (A) The presence of the catalyst results in an overall
                 reaction that releases less energy.

           (B) The presence of the catalyst results in a reaction
              pathway that requires a lower activation energy.

           (C) The presence of the catalyst results in an overall
                 reaction that requires more energy.

          (D) The presence of the catalyst results in a reac-
                 tion pathway that requires a greater activation
                energy.

candidates.name: Catalysis
candidates.definition: How catalysts increase rate by providing an alternative mechanism with lower activation energy while being regenerated and leaving ΔH and K unchanged.
candidates.include: Tag when a catalyst's effect on mechanism, energy profile, rate, ΔH or equilibrium must be identified or explained.
candidates.exclude: Do not tag intermediates questions without a catalyst.
